“周尘，你今天必须入赘玉女宫，侍奉玉清仙子！”
“玉清仙子美若天仙，让你入赘，是便宜你了！”
……
……
大乾王朝，天风城，林家。
“这里…是哪里？”
“我又是谁？”
看着周围的陌生环境，周尘半晌之后这才反应过来。
他，周尘。
成长十六年，终于在这一刻，打破胎中之谜，觉醒前世记忆。
周尘猛地抬首，眼前正是一位少女。
她一身鹅黄衫裙，发髻微挽，红唇贝齿，原本该是清丽出尘的容颜，此刻却被一抹冰冷覆盖。
“无极哥哥已然拜入天地门，前途无量，岂能去那种地方白白葬送？”
“你生的俊朗，玉清仙子一定会喜欢你，替无极哥哥去玉女宫入赘，是你的福分。”
周尘脸色一沉，记忆疯狂涌来。
自己是一枚孤儿，在十六年前被林家一位好心人收养。
好心人名为林义，他还有一个女儿，算是周尘的义姐。
不过除了义父和义姐之外，他和林家其他人并不熟悉。
眼前这个明艳少女林婉儿，正是自己的白月光。

但自己痴恋她多年，她却从未正眼相待。
而林婉儿喜欢的，自始至终都只是天风城的骄阳，城主之子赵无极。
不过如今自己觉醒前世记忆，再也不是之前的周尘，自然舔不了一点。
“我不去！”
“整个青州，谁人不知玉女宫全是妖女！”
“入赘者，皆成炉鼎，被那妖女吕玉清采补至死。”
“你让我替赵无极去？林婉儿，你这分明是要我死！”
玉女宫，青州凶名赫赫的势力。
宫主吕玉清，数年前横空出世，创立玉女宫。
每年，玉女宫都以“入赘”之名，在青州各城挑选男子入宫“侍奉”吕玉清。
入赘者，尽数沦为炉鼎，被吸干元阳精魄而亡。
曾有青州强者联手讨伐，却被吕玉清轻易击溃。
自此，再无人敢触其锋芒，凡被选中的男子，无人敢违逆。
七日前，玉女宫选中了天风城的赵无极。
不过林婉儿不想让赵无极去，而是想让她的舔狗周尘代替她的无极哥哥，去入赘玉女宫。
林婉儿冷笑一声：“不去？那我就帮你一把。”
此话一出，周尘骤然发觉体内灵力迅速凝滞，竟连一丝气息都无法调动！
“你这贱人！”
“刚才那杯酒……有毒！”
他想了起来，刚刚进入厅堂的时候，林婉儿假意安抚，递给他一杯酒，自己毫无防备便饮下了！

“现在才明白？晚了！”
content_en:
;;
"Zhou Chen, you must enter the Jade Girl Palace today to serve Fairy Yuqing!"
"Fairy Yuqing is as beautiful as a fairy. It is an advantage for you to marry her!"
…
…
Daqian Dynasty, Tianfeng City, Lin family.
"Where...is this?"
"Who am I?"
Looking at the unfamiliar environment around him, Zhou Chen reacted after a while.
Him, Zhou Chen.
After sixteen years of growth, finally at this moment, the mystery of the womb was broken and the memory of the past life was awakened.
Zhou Chen suddenly raised his head, and in front of him was a young girl.
She was wearing a goose-yellow shirt and skirt, her hair was slightly pulled up in a bun, and her red lips and teeth were originally beautiful. However, at this moment, she was covered by a touch of coldness.
"Brother Wuji has already entered the gate of heaven and earth and has a bright future. How can he go to a place like that and die in vain?"
"You are handsome. Fairy Yuqing will definitely like you. It will be your blessing to go to the Jade Girl Palace for brother Wuji."
Zhou Chen's face darkened, and memories rushed back crazily.
He is an orphan who was adopted by a kind-hearted person from the Lin family sixteen years ago.
The good-hearted person is named Lin Yi, and he also has a daughter, who is regarded as Zhou Chen's adopted sister.
However, except for his adopted father and adopted sister, he was not familiar with the rest of the Lin family.
The bright girl Lin Wan'er in front of her is her own Bai Yueguang.
But I have been obsessed with her for many years, but she has never looked at him.
But what Lin Wan'er liked from beginning to end was just the blazing sun of Tianfeng City, Zhao Wuji, the son of the city lord.
But now that I have awakened the memory of my past life, I am no longer the Zhou Chen I was before, so naturally I can't lick it at all.
"I'm not going!"
"In the entire Qingzhou, no one knows that the Jade Girl Palace is full of witches!"
"Everyone who gets married will become a furnace and be picked up and nourished by the witch Lu Yuqing until they die."
"You want me to go for Zhao Wuji? Lin Waner, you clearly want me to die!"
Jade Girl Palace, a notorious force in Qingzhou.
The master of the palace, Lu Yuqing, came out of nowhere a few years ago and founded the Jade Girl Palace.
Every year, the Jade Girl Palace selects men from various cities in Qingzhou to enter the palace to "serve" Lu Yuqing in the name of "bringing into the family".
Those who married into wives were all reduced to furnace cauldrons, drained of their Yuanyang essence and died.
There were once strong men from Qingzhou who joined forces to attack, but were easily defeated by Lu Yuqing.
From then on, no one dared to touch its edge, and no one who was chosen dared to disobey.
Seven days ago, the Jade Girl Palace selected Zhao Wuji from Tianfeng City.
However, Lin Wan'er didn't want Zhao Wuji to go, but wanted her licking dog Zhou Chen to replace her brother Wuji to enter the Palace of the Married Jade Lady.
Lin Wan'er sneered: "Don't want to go? Then I will help you."
As soon as these words came out, Zhou Chen suddenly felt that the spiritual power in his body was rapidly stagnating, and he was unable to mobilize even a breath!
"You bitch!"
"That glass of wine just now... was poisonous!"
He remembered that when he first entered the hall, Lin Wan'er pretended to comfort him and handed him a glass of wine, which he drank without any precautions!
"You understand now? It's too late!"
